document.cue: Describe a time when you helped someone in your community.

text: I'd like to describe a time when I helped an elderly neighbour in my building. His name is Mr Bakhyt, he's in his seventies, and he lives alone on the floor below me. This happened last winter, so it was about ten months ago.

One evening I met him in the stairwell holding a brand-new smartphone and looking quite lost. His son, who works in Germany, had sent it to him as a gift so that they could have video calls, but he had no idea how to use it. So I invited him into my flat, and over the next two hours we set up his account, installed a messaging app and practised calling his son. I also wrote down the steps on a piece of paper in big letters, which he could easily read. In the following weeks I popped in a couple of times to check that he was coping.

He was absolutely delighted. When he finally saw his son's face on the screen, his eyes filled with tears and he kept thanking me. A few days later his wife brought us a huge plate of homemade pastries. I decided to help him because I know how lonely it can be when your family lives far away, and technology was the only thing standing between him and his son. Besides, it took me only a couple of hours, but it meant the world to him.

tips.en: Past perfect (had sent) explains something that happened before the main story.
tips.kk: Past perfect (had sent) негізгі оқиғадан бұрынғы жағдайды түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Past perfect (had sent) объясняет событие до основного рассказа.
tips.example: His son, who works in Germany, had sent it to him as a gift

tips.en: A concrete detail such as tears or pastries brings the story to life.
tips.kk: Нақты бөлшек (көз жасы, тағам) әңгімені жандандырады.
tips.ru: Конкретная деталь (слёзы, пирожки) делает рассказ живым.
tips.example: his eyes filled with tears and he kept thanking me

tips.en: It meant the world to him is a natural idiom for strong feeling.
tips.kk: It meant the world to him — күшті эмоцияға арналған табиғи идиома.
tips.ru: It meant the world to him — естественная идиома для сильной эмоции.
tips.example: it meant the world to him

note.en: A casual phrasal verb for a short visit.
note.kk: Қысқа уақытқа соғу — ауызекі фразалық етістік.

note.en: Names the person and situation and sets the time of the event.
note.kk: Адамды және жағдайды атап, оқиғаның уақытын белгілейді.
note.ru: Называет человека и обстоятельства, задаёт время события.

note.en: Narrates in order: the problem, the actions, the follow-up.
note.kk: Оқиғаны ретімен баяндайды: мәселе, әрекеттер, жалғасы.
note.ru: Рассказывает историю по порядку: проблема, действия, продолжение.

note.en: Describes the reaction, explains the motive and ends with an emotional line.
note.kk: Реакцияны сипаттап, себепті түсіндіреді және эмоциялық сөйлеммен аяқтайды.
note.ru: Описывает реакцию и объясняет мотив, завершая эмоциональной фразой.

document.title: Helping a neighbour
bullets: and explain why you decided to help.
